title: D.N.Angel
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: On his fourteenth birthday, middle schooler Daisuke Niwa inherits a family condition: when he sees his crush Risa, he turns into the legendary phantom thief Dark, and he only turns back when Dark sees Risa's twin, Riku. Pursued by the police and by classmate Satoshi Hiwatari, the commissioner's son, Daisuke shares his body with Dark while trying to sort out his love life (publisher blurbs via AniList and MU).
life_message: Accepting the other side of yourself and being honest about love lets a divided person become whole.
